name: crypto-retained-panel
notes: Original W5 feature pipeline, same start and feature rules; only extend tapes to exclusive Oct12. No native market outcomes or later spot observations. No fit.

streams.notes: Puts the four Binance streams into the run identity (ADR-0243): the tape reader reads the day files itself, which a transform's fingerprint would not cover, so this data node fingerprints each stream's snapshot hash and the reader refuses a store that moved since. Keys are <ASSET>_<tape> and must match tapes.assets (a test pins it).

tapes.notes: Reads the day files of the four tapes that the window [start_ms, end_ms) touches into the row lists MinuteFeatures takes, and keeps only rows inside it. start_ms is W1's start (2023-06-20) and end_ms is W2's end (2026-08-01), both UTC midnight and end-exclusive: this is the ONE place the panel's bounds live. A test pins the kline fields to what MinuteFeatures requires and to the layouts in source-binance-*.json. The BVOL tape has 26 missing days per asset; MinuteFeatures treats BVOL as optional and never refuses a row for it. bucket_last_ms (bvol, 60000): the BVOL tape is second-resolution (about 5 million rows a month), and the BVol family only ever reads the newest reading strictly before a minute edge, so the reader keeps the last finite reading of each minute with its own timestamp (exact, pinned by a test; the unreduced build held about 1.9 GB per month as dicts and was OOM-killed at 16 GB). output arrays: the tapes leave as {asset: {field: array}} and MinuteFeatures reads them without one Python dict per row (measured: 12 months of rows as dicts cost 1.2 GB resident, so the 37-month window about 3.7 GB, before any feature was computed).

features.notes: Every knob but the asset pair and emit is MinuteFeatures' own default (scale grid 5, 15, 60, 240, 1440, 10080 minutes; all ten families; labels y_h1..y_h15 over the 60-minute RMS scale, emitted as meta__scale). emit=columns builds the array view only: a 3-million-row panel cannot hold one dict per row. The ablation arms (features-arms.json) are column selectors over this one panel, so every arm sees identical rows.

panel.notes: The panel directory (manifest.json + features/labels/time/group/reference/run .npy, each hashed). path is RELATIVE to the invoking directory, which must hold `panels/` and not `panels/minute-w1w2` (the writer refuses an existing destination; a rebuild is a new name). Every column MinuteFeatures emits other than time_ms, asset, meta__scale and y_h* is a feature, in the node's order: the 88 family columns and the 3 raw seq__ channels. step_ms 60000 is the bar the panel's gap-safe windows are counted in. horizons 1..15 is max_horizon's default; a test pins the two equal.
